pages.text: Between the records of the frozen wastes and the casting of soul-frozen cores, you wondered whether a snow golem's strength could be pushed to its limit. Trial and error gave you the rite to wake a twisted winter warden - and so the Mutant Snow Golem Servant.
Cap it with a $(l)Carved Pumpkin$(), then right-click the pumpkin with a $(l)Mutating Potion$().

A plain and sturdy mutation, it attacks by hurling blocks of ice.$(br)You may also give it a $(item)Frost Nova Focus$(), a $(item)Chilling Focus$() and a $(item)Stray Soul Jar$() to $(l:supreme/servants_skills/mutant_snow_golem_servant)strengthen$() it.$(br)Throw $(item)Snowballs$() at your Mutant Snow Golem Servant to heal it.
You can throw $(item)snowballs$() at a Mutant Snow Golem Servant to heal it.
